scripts.start: HOME="$PWD/.home" EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$PWD/.expo-local/config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$PWD/.expo-local/cache" expo start
scripts.start:clear: HOME="$PWD/.home" EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$PWD/.expo-local/config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$PWD/.expo-local/cache" expo start --clear
scripts.start:phone: HOME="$PWD/.home" EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$PWD/.expo-local/config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$PWD/.expo-local/cache" REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_HOSTNAME=192.168.40.33 expo start --lan --clear
scripts.android: HOME="$PWD/.home" EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$PWD/.expo-local/config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$PWD/.expo-local/cache" expo start --android
scripts.ios: HOME="$PWD/.home" EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$PWD/.expo-local/config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$PWD/.expo-local/cache" expo start --ios
scripts.web: HOME="$PWD/.home" EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$PWD/.expo-local/config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$PWD/.expo-local/cache" expo start --web
scripts.export:web: HOME="$PWD/.home" EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$PWD/.expo-local/config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$PWD/.expo-local/cache" expo export --platform web
scripts.preview:web: npm run export:web && cd dist && python3 -m http.server 8082
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npx eslint . --no-cache && npm run export:web
